recipes.label: Searching for the Path to Crossrow?
recipes.startdescription:
The path to the Crossrow has been concealed by the power of the Velvet, but nothing can remain hidden forever – especially for the covenantal land that spreads enlightenment.

[Collecting seven 'Haunting Melodies' will reveal the path to the Crossrow.]

recipes.label: Searching for the Path to Crossrow
recipes.startdescription:
The fragmented echoes interweave into a bright melody, guiding me through the hazy mist --

[This will consume seven 'Haunting Melodies' and reveal the path to Crossrow.]

recipes.label: Attacking My Enemy Through Her Flaws?
recipes.startdescription: My enemy has already shown enough flaws in this battle. It's time for her to bleed. [You could attempt to wound Skadi through a challenge, prepare large amont Edge, Forge and Winter would help you succeed.]

recipes.label: Attacking My Enemy?
recipes.startdescription: My enemy has not yet revealed enough flaws in the battle, but I can still attempt to use powerful force - or extraordinary abilities to break through her defense. [You could attempt to wound Skadi through a challenge, prepare large amount of Edge and Lantern would help you succeed. Spending a total of three 'A Chance to Strike Back?' can make the challenge easier.]

recipes.label: Attack Thwarted!
recipes.startdescription: My attack was easily dispelled by the enemy's defense. 'Pathetic,' Skadi scoffs.

recipes.startdescription: I summon untamed flame to burn away the foe's protection, forcing her utterly exposed to my attack—

recipes.label: Respond with Finality
recipes.startdescription: The final frost shatters the foe's protection, forcing her utterly exposed to my attack—
I still remember the pain and shame of Caen vividly. Now, at last, I have made my enemy taste something akin to it.

recipes.label: Use Resting Place
recipes.startdescription: Withdraw from worldly affairs and take a brief respite...
recipes.description: ...then return to the task once more.

recipes.label: In Exchange for Value
recipes.startdescription: Each takes what they need.

recipes.label: Clarified with Reason
recipes.startdescription: Once gains and losses are clearly weighed, reason can take the lead.
recipes.description: Thus I have won their support.

recipes.label: With Passionate Oratory
recipes.startdescription: Passion can sway the gullible—even when the speech lacks solid grounds.
recipes.description: Thus I have won their support.

recipes.label: Lies and Bluffs
recipes.startdescription: A flaw that can be manipulated lies at the very core of the human soul—its name is fear and uncertainty.
recipes.description: Thus I have won their support.

recipes.label: Greed and Deception
recipes.startdescription: Before the allure of profit, reason and restraint are worth nothing.
recipes.description: Thus I have won their support.

recipes.label: Misguided Loyalty
recipes.startdescription: After nightfall, everything will remain as it was—and they will not realize that the object of their loyalty has changed.
recipes.description: Thus I have won their support.

recipes.label: Reshaped Perception
recipes.startdescription: In the blinding light, they will learn a discipline unlike any they have known before.
recipes.description: Thus I have won their support.

recipes.label: Salvage Usable Supplies
recipes.startdescription:
The target location may hold quite valuable materials, but I must exert effort to navigate the chaos along the way.

[Meet the threshold to achieve the objective.]

recipes.label: Salvage Usable Supplies
recipes.startdescription:
A modicum of effort is enough to resolve the trivial troubles along the road.

[This will take some time and randomly grant you useful resources, though there is a small chance of leaving traces.]
recipes.description: These will prove handy on the journey ahead.

recipes.label: Confiscating Supplies from Local Farms
recipes.startdescription: Hunger can drive people to madness—but the gap in power, along with the fear of authority and the flames of war, can overwhelm it.
recipes.description: Thus, they obediently hand over their surplus supplies and tighten their belts in preparation for the days ahead.
